title: kya ghadeer se
body:
mai kis tarha se batau ke kya ghadeer se hai
quda ka deen to kya qud quda ghadeer se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
azaa'n me naame ali sunke jo machalte ho
tumhara zaqm abhi tak hara ghadeer se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
batau ek hi misre me kya munafiq hai
wo kalma goh hai magar bhaagta ghadeer se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
laga raha hai jo fatwe hussain ke gham par
qasam quda ki use mas'alaa ghadeer se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
tu jisko dhoond raha hai aye sheq masjid me
bahisht jaane ka wo raasta ghadeer se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ke lehje me bola jo barsare meraaj
nabi ke lehje me wo bolta ghadeer se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
raabta qud karega us se quda
gar tera raabta ghadeer se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
fat'he qaibar ke maal se ulfat
shaiq ji ko gila ghadeer se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aapka kya shaiq moulvi saahib
ambiya ki baqa ghadeer se hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch nahi deen karbala ke baghair
aur khud karbala ghadeer se hai
